desc: Helsinki mobile games studio behind Empires & Puzzles, owned by Zynga, itself part of Take-Two Interactive.

fin.value_orig: 80% for USD 330m cash + USD 230m Zynga stock (2018/19); earnouts USD 122m (2020) and USD 240m (2021); total over USD 922m

outstanding: Current revenue and headcount (47 is 2018); no newsroom checked; budget likely controlled by Zynga/Take-Two.
